newsitem.title: FRANCE: Scattered showers in west France, more on the way.
newsitem.headline: Scattered showers in west France, more on the way.

text.p: Light rains fell over western regions on Sunday and more rain was expected across France in coming days to bring relief to farmers suffering from a prolonged dry spell, Meteo France said.
Rainy conditions and lower temperatures were expected to last until mid-week, forecasters said.
"The forecast is scattered showers over Brittany and Normandy moving eastward on Sunday with a clear change in the weather pattern by Monday," one forecaster said.
Meteo France said Monday's rain will bring 10-15 mm across France, but that parts of southwest and the Alps could get as much as 25-30 mm.
Temperatures will reach 22-23 degrees in the north and 24-25 degrees in the south on Sunday, but are set to decline by Monday.
By Wednesday temperatures will below normal for spring with 11 degrees for the north and 15 degrees for the south, forecasters said.
Farmers are still desparate for rain despite wet weather early last week. The rain was not enough to help the crops recover from the effects of a three-month drought.
